# Condition

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Condition>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A describable circumstance — the trigger of a conditional norm, the activation context of a persona, the antecedent of a causal link (risk design). The canonical form is PROSE ([`gmeow:conditionText`](../properties/gmeow-conditionText.md), mandatory by SHACL); machine formalizations attach via [`gmeow:formalizedAs`](../properties/gmeow-formalizedAs.md), and each formalization is a claim of equivalence to the prose, challengeable through the statement layer. Whether the condition held at some moment is a [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md) — a vantage-indexed [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) — never a graph entailment. The ontology stores conditions; it never executes them ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a describable circumstance — a norm's trigger, a persona's activation context, a causal antecedent — whose canonical form is prose and whose holding is observed, never entailed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid executing or evaluating a condition during validation (the ontology stores conditions, never runs them — [Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)) and avoid treating an attached formalization as the canonical form; the prose is canonical.

### How to use

- Mint the condition with mandatory [`gmeow:conditionText`](../properties/gmeow-conditionText.md) prose, attach machine formalizations via [`gmeow:formalizedAs`](../properties/gmeow-formalizedAs.md) (each a challengeable equivalence claim), and record whether it held as a [`gmeow:ConditionEvaluation`](gmeow-ConditionEvaluation.md).

### Examples

- ex:c1 a [`gmeow:Condition`](gmeow-Condition.md); [`gmeow:conditionText`](../properties/gmeow-conditionText.md) "the data subject has requested erasure".
